sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Served as a first-round judge at the Google I/O Hackathon in San Francisco, hosted by Cerebral Valley in partnership with Google DeepMind, where teams turned the latest I/O releases into working products built with Gemini and Gemma across AI Studio, Antigravity, and Google's newest developer tools. Evaluated 21 projects through 3-minute pitches and live Q&A, scoring each on impact potential, live demo execution, and creativity and originality via the CV judging platform.
